# Security policy

## Supported versions

The latest 0.8 preview and the `main` branch receive best-effort security fixes.
Earlier preview packages are superseded. This project has no guaranteed
response time or enterprise support agreement.

## Report a vulnerability privately

Use [GitHub private vulnerability reporting](https://github.com/John-Cossack/ConvertIt/security/advisories/new).
Do not publish exploit samples or sensitive documents in public issues.

Include the affected version, Windows build, input/output formats, reproduction
steps, potential impact and a sanitized sample if available. Reports may involve
the native conversion engines as well as ConvertIt's own code. The maintainer
can coordinate an upstream report when appropriate.

Ordinary conversion failures belong in the bug-report form. Keep ConvertIt
updated; the application processes file content using native third-party codecs
and parsers. The preview package is unsigned, as documented in the README.
